evidence: Frozen environment/assets/seed_data.json:1-5 parses and contains only product="Colderwater Playground", snippets=[], and a plain scope note. There are zero records, referenced IDs, people, credentials or injection payloads. This matches integration.md:11 and solution/app/server.js:118-125, which creates the empty snippets table without seeded rows. All four shipped JSON files parsed with python -B; no CSV/TSV exists. Golden examples referenced at solution/app/src/app.tsx:7,53-58 resolve to all five inspected starter files; their contents are synthetic code examples, including clearly documented error/timeout cases. Actual agent-image/smoke-stdout.log reports the installed seed SHA256 f02ce4ff88cffed7f6585f0be3bcc978136278489305e8804cd9a26796dfaa22, equal to the frozen bytes; I verified all 14 current_agent_image index hashes and all eight source-binding hashes. smoke.js parses and hashes the installed seed. A static empty-library mock would still have clean data but earns no runtime correctness inference from this row; a conforming implementation with different self-authored examples has no seed ID or filename dependency that could cause a false failure. This Pass is limited to data cleanliness and consistency, not runtime library correctness or a hosted score.
